div.div: A task is ready only when every dependency is done, and blocked once one failed or paused. part runs over sim-a alone once its inputs settle. The job pauses only when nothing runs or is ready. A resume runs again every task that is not done, and part too, since it ran without sim-c.

div.div: Manual pause while sim-a and sim-b run: to_interrupt gives sim-b (checkpoint), sim-a runs to completion, sim-c stays ready, and the job pauses with reason operator once nothing runs.

div.div: sim-b succeeds and part has no allow_partial: part is blocked by sim-c like agg, and the job ends failed with reason retries-exhausted: sim-c. A compile exhausting after a resume pauses with resume-compile-failed.
